frozenEvaluation.note: V3 final 33M checkpoint only: 128 arenas, four 20-second rounds per arena on each fighter side, with fresh Philox action RNG seed 10001 and recurrent resets at terminals. Arena starts are fixed; seeds vary action draws, not geometry. No diagnostic override. Results do not apply to longer human rounds, the early 1M checkpoint, greedy inference, or another physics version.

note: Completed historical V3 points-only headless C++/CUDA training on Spark; this is not a live training job. Full-run SPS is 33,554,432 learner transitions divided by 13.751488208770752 training-loop seconds, including rollout and PPO across 512 arenas and excluding startup. It is not the final rolling-window SPS or browser frame rate. Physical knockdowns are not modeled; hits do not reset positions. Frozen strength belongs to the exact final checkpoint and sampled BF16 mode above. High scripted win rate does not establish human-level strength, generalization to other opponents, or authentic REK parity. V2 checkpoints and results are separate historical artifacts, not V3 results. No V3 league ranking has yet been measured.
